generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a medium-sized tree with a narrow, rounded crown, opposite branching and pinnately compound leaves of five to seven broad leaflets. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 18 m tall and 40 cm across at breast height at 50 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: light green leaves; grey-brown bark in interlacing diamond ridges. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: dense hanging clusters of single green samaras 3 to 5 cm long. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: small flowers before the leaves in March and April; samaras green in summer, tan from September, falling into the winter. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): grey-brown bark deeply furrowed into interlacing ridges; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured. Leaf families (plant roadmap P4, `families`): sun leaflets narrower than shade leaflets; set from general knowledge of sun and shade leaves and juvenile foliage, not measured.
